## 0.10.0
### What's New
- Added third-party taps. Add a developer's own Homebrew tap from the new Taps page to browse, install and update its apps next to the rest - Added Touch ID for the administrator password. Turn it on in Settings, General - Added pinning, so a pinned app stays at its installed version and is never offered an update. Manage pins in Shelf Setup - Added a Fonts category that lists every Homebrew font like an app - Added an Application Directory setting in Settings, Homebrew, Paths for installing apps outside /Applications - Added deprecated, disabled and removed casks to Installed and search, with a status that explains why Homebrew retired them
### Improvements
- Improved launch time, scrolling and typing in search, with fewer freezes - Improved hints, which now open instantly as popovers when you hover - Improved the Browse House Pick so it no longer changes with the sort order
### Bug Fixes
- Fixed updates failing when an app was renamed or moved after install, with a new Force Update option - Fixed pasting into the administrator password prompt, and the prompt closing silently when Allow was clicked with an empty field - Fixed the search clear button leaving old results on the page - Fixed CaskHub retrying old queued analytics calls after Share anonymous usage analytics was turned off
## 0.9.3
### Improvements
- Added a Full Disk Access row to Settings, General, Permissions - Improved the Uninstall confirmation to explain when app data cannot be removed without Full Disk Access, with an option to uninstall and keep the data - Added the terminal icon for more command-line tools
### Bug Fixes
- Fixed uninstalls leaving apps half-removed when Remove app data on uninstall is on and CaskHub does not have Full Disk Access - Fixed half-uninstalled apps offering Repair & Reinstall instead of finishing the uninstall - Fixed the welcome screen not letting you pick Light or Dark
## 0.9.2
### Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where CaskHub could quit unexpectedly when the Uninstall confirmation or an error alert opened on macOS 26 and later
## 0.9.1
### Bug Fixes
- Fixed the sort and time period menus in the toolbar showing only icons on macOS 27
## 0.9.0
### What's New
- Added a Standard look with native macOS surfaces and Liquid Glass toolbar controls, next to Classic. Switch any time in Settings, Appearance - Added simultaneous downloads, up to three at a time, so Update All and Brewfile imports finish sooner - Added cancelling an install or update while it is queued or downloading - Added a welcome tour for new installs and a What's New card after each update - Added a separate section in Installed for apps managed outside Homebrew, with a switch in Settings, General - Added a Refresh button to the Updates toolbar
### Improvements
- Updates with Greedy off now match what Homebrew itself lists as outdated - Cask icons now share one size with a soft shadow, and no longer flash while scrolling - Status bar now shows how many apps are downloading and queued during Update All and Brewfile imports - Health and Shelf Setup buttons now match the size of catalog buttons
### Bug Fixes
- Fixed updates being offered again and again for apps Homebrew already considers up to date - Fixed updates being offered for a version built for a different macOS version or processor - Fixed standalone Microsoft apps such as Teams and OneDrive being claimed by the Office suite - Fixed Excel and similar apps disappearing from Installed after updating themselves
